content.title: Who is Cameron Young's caddie? Meet former Wake Forest teammate Kyle Sterbinsky and his history with Masters leader
content.text: Who is Cameron Young's caddie? Meet former Wake Forest teammate Kyle Sterbinsky and his history with Masters leader originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.In the past year, Cameron Young has vaulted to the top of the golf world with multiple wins, as he now has a chance to secure a green jacket for the first time.AdvertisementYoung was once a talented golfer who was struggling to put it all together, but something clicked last spring. That is when he made a caddie change, one of several in his career, and hired one of his best friends from college to carry his bag during tournaments.Since then, Young has taken off and has played the best golf of his career, putting him right in the mix for any of golf's four majors in 2026. Get to know Cameron Young's caddie and how he made a difference in the American golfer's golf game.SN's MASTERS HQ:Live Masters leaderboard | Masters TV coverage | Live streamingCameron Young has had a few different caddies in his career, but he has found the most success after pairing with his former college teammate, Kyle Sterbinsky. Since partnering with Sterbinsky, Young has picked up his first two wins on the PGA Tour and vaulted to third in the Official World Golf Rankings.AdvertisementCaddies are crucial for golfers, as partnerships are key for professionals to find success at the highest level. Therefore, Young has seemingly found the right partner as he looks to become one of the best players in the world.Sterbinsky was still trying to make a career out of playing on mini tours last year when Young, who struggled to start the year, asked him to caddie."He was nearing the end of when he was going to keep playing or not. I needed a change. Things were going poorly, and when things are going bad, you change something," Young said.Young claims that Sterbinsky's ability to read greens has been crucial to his turnaround, since putting was such a problem for him earlier in his career.What impacted can a caddie have?According to Cam Young his caddie, and former college teammate, Kyle Sterbinsky. is one of the best green readers he knows.In 2024, Cam Young was one of the worst putters on Tour. He ranked 145th, losing -0.23 shots per round.In the 10 months… pic.twitter.com/dvxltsPM2E— Jamie Kennedy (@jamierkennedy) March 16, 2026MORE: Where Cameron Young's Masters comeback would rank all-timeAdvertisementCameron Young results with Kyle SterbinskySterbinsky began caddying for Young in the Spring of 2025, and it's a big reason why Young has improved his play. Young picked up his first two PGA Tour wins with Sterbinsky on his bag, going along with seven overall top-five finishes and a strong performance at the 2025 Ryder Cup.As a result, Young is currently ranked No. 3 in the Official World Golf Rankings, the highest Young has ever been ranked in his career and significantly up from 67 when Sterbinsky first joined him. After four years of being a professional, Young has finally found the right formula to be successful at the highest level of the sport."He's great at reading greens, I think he's very quickly picking up a lot of the technical skills that it requires to be a really. good caddie out here," Young said after winning the Wyndham Championship last Summer. "He's been a great resource for me."While the plan was for this to be a temporary pairing, Young's success with Sterbinsky on the bag kept the two together.Advertisement"I didn't want to force his hand," Young said, via the Golf Channel. "He said, 'Yes, I'll work for you as long as you want.' It was going to be a couple of weeks. Played well. Another four weeks. Played well. And here we are."MORE:Has Cameron Young won a major?Who is Kyle Sterbinsky?Kyle Sterbinsky is a former collegiate and professional golfer who retired from the sport to be a caddie for Cameron Young. Sterbinsky spent four years at Wake Forest playing golf alongside Young, and attempted to become a professional in the years after graduating.From 2020 to 2023, Sterbinsky spent time on the Minor League Golf Tour, producing several top-10 finishes in that span. He turned pro in May of 2023, making a few starts on the Korn Ferry Tour, but was unable to progress his career beyond that as he failed to qualify for the DP World Tour.AdvertisementMORE:Where is Cameron Young from?Kyle Sterbinsky college careerKyle Sterbinsky played college golf at Wake Forest from 2015 to 2019, playing more early in his career than later. In his freshman and sophomore seasons, Sterbinsky played in 16 events in those two seasons, qualifying for the 2016 U.S. Amateur Championship in the process.Sterbinsky's best finish in college was a tied-for-third at a tournament in his sophomore season, and also had a few more top-15 finishes. As a freshman, Sterbinsky averaged a score of 72.12, and as a sophomore he averaged a 74.11. However, Sterbinsky redshirted in his junior season, then played just one event in his senior year.
